scope.summary: BkSkin integration test (spec 13.22 acceptance; REQ-033/036, PREQ-004/008/025/026): full tone sweep including dark skins with seamless genital blend (GENITAL_BLEND_VALID green per tone), wet-layer bake through the MT-573 pipeline, and extreme-morph strain compensation plus areola re-projection proven on archetype (a), with ledger replay reproducing the bake byte-identically.
acceptance_criteria: Tone sweep end to end: the documented tone set (pale to very dark) runs the genital blend and GENITAL_BLEND_VALID reports green for every tone with capture refs attached.
Wet-layer bake: an arousal-ramped wet state bakes through the MT-573 pipeline with deterministic outputs.
Archetype (a) at extreme channels: strain compensation holds the detail-density bound (MT-570) and areola re-projection places correctly (MT-571 reuse).
Replay: skin configuration reconstructs from the EventLedger and the re-run bake is byte-identical; Argus captures persist for operator review.
scope.risk_if_missed: Tone sweep plus genital blend plus strain compensation is the contractually named BkSkin acceptance surface; without this integration proof, individually green MTs can still compose into seamed, smeared, or tone-broken production skin.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
